title: Library Lending and Returning
instructions: Implement `Library.lend_book` and `Library.return_book` in `library.py`, using the provided model classes in `models.py`. Validate in this order before changing anything: the item must be a `Borrowable` (`TypeError`), the book must be available and the member under their limit (`ValueError`). The exact messages are part of the contract.

evidence.label: A successful lend returns a Loan and updates book and member
A non-borrowable item raises TypeError('Item is not borrowable')
An unavailable book raises ValueError('Book not available')
The member limit raises ValueError('Borrow limit reached')
Rules are checked in the documented order
A failed lend changes no state
Returning restores availability and the borrow count
A member can borrow again after returning at the limit
The service goes through the member's methods
